name: Multi-hop Proxy

evidence.rationale: This technique may be lessened or mitigated though the use of firewall policy that constrains relay and redirect paths.
Destination filtering may prevent access to identified anonymity or command-and-control infrastructure.
Use network allow and block lists to restrict traffic to known anonymity networks and command-and-control infrastructure that may be chained together as multi-hop proxy destinations.
Application-layer gateways can restrict known anonymization and proxy services that may be chained together to form multi-hop proxy infrastructure.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.

An empty mitigation list means that this release links no mitigation, not that no mitigation exists. agent_related is derived by this project from names.
